-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Box[T any] struct {
	V int
}

func (b Box[T]) Add(x, y int) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return x + y + n + b.V
}

func (b Box[T]) Add2(x, y int) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return x + y + n + b.V
}

type Pair struct {
	A int
	B string
}

func pair() (int, int) {
	return 2, 3
}

func mkBox() Box[Pair] {
	return Box[Pair]{V: 4}
}

func seven(x int) int {
	return x
}

func getSeven() func(int) int {
	return seven
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println((mkBox()).Add((pair())))
	b := Box[Pair]{V: 1}
	fmt.Println(b.Add2(1, (seven)(7)))
	fmt.Println(b.Add2(1, (getSeven())(7)))
}
